text.p: 3-Dimensional Pharmaceuticals Inc and ViroPharma Inc said Wednesday they entered into an agreement in which 3DP will use its DirectedDiversity technology to assist ViroPharma in the discovery and refinement of antiviral pharmaceuticals.

The companies said in a release that the pharmaceuticals are for the treatment of diseases caused by RNA viruses, which are responsible for the majority of human viral diseases, causing illnesses ranging from acute and chronic ailments to fatal infections.

The agreement calls for 3-Dimensional to use its DirectedDiversity chemi-informatic technology for combinatorial chemistry to generate, search, and refine the properties of compound libraries based on ViroPharma's proprietary chemistry and antiviral lead series.
Compounds produced under the agreement will be synthesized by ViroPharma and tested in their proprietary RNA replication assays.

3-Dimensional will receive a technology access fee, milestone payments and royalties, while ViroPharma will retain commercialization rights to drugs discovered through the collaboration, the companies said.
